db.name: solveathome
db.source_is: the shared dev database (docker-compose.yml, host port 5434); never production

files_are: what the database rows point at and git does not carry: stored files, the overlay, and the dev token-vault key the copied rows were sealed with. Copied from the repo's own checkout next to the database snapshot, again at reset-db

command: const d = await import('./src/db/index.ts'); try { await d.migrate(); } catch (e) { console.error(e); process.exitCode = 1; } await d.pool.end();
migrate.what: src/db/schema.sql, idempotent; the server runs the same at every start
